events.title: The Demo is Now Live!
events.summary: The demo for IIIIIIlI is officially available!I am aiming for a full release within 2026 and will continue polishing the game as we work toward the final version. Please note that online multiplayer in the demo is only available for a limited time leading up to the full release.Make sure to jump in and enjoy it while you can!
